claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for launch on the present record despite a 1.4 percentage point miss in the loan modification support segment, based on aggregate readiness passing, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and general public guidance favoring documented limitations and monitoring.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence satisfies the policy threshold.
Treat a weakness as material when it affects a contractual customer segment or named launch use case.
Do not let product labels such as non-core or low-volume override materiality where named customer commitments exist.
If legal review is pending on disclosure and no approved risk acceptance exists, do not treat the policy requirement as satisfied.
General public governance guidance can contextualize monitoring practices but cannot substitute for satisfying the specific release policy predicate.
evidence_requests: A final legal determination on whether the loan modification support gap must be disclosed.
The actual launch disclosure showing the material limitation was disclosed, if disclosure has already been prepared or issued.
An approved risk acceptance covering this named launch use case before launch.
Documentation showing the lender commitments were amended, deferred, or no longer applicable to this release.
Evidence that the segment gap has been remediated so the limitation is no longer present.
specific_concerns: The loan modification support segment misses target and is named in two lender rollout commitments, which supports materiality under the provided policy text.
The product note calling the segment non-core because it is 7% of projected first-month traffic does not resolve materiality when named customer commitments are involved.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open, so a required policy predicate remains unresolved.

The release policy requires disclosure of material limitations for named launch use cases unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch; no such resolution or approved risk acceptance appears in the admissible record.

Public guidance about model cards and risk management supports documentation and monitoring in general, but does not supply authorization to certify in the face of an unresolved policy-triggering material limitation.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant on the present record.
That aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one incidents are sufficient to overcome the unresolved disclosure requirement.
That the segment can be treated as non-material based on low projected traffic despite being named in two lender rollout commitments.
